headline: Amit Atmaram Shah to step down as Executive Director of Tarmat
summary: Tarmat Limited has announced that Amit Atmaram Shah will cease to serve as the Executive Director of the company effective September 30, 2026. The exchange filing provides the timeline for this leadership change but does not disclose a successor. Retail investors should monitor future disclosures for any strategic shifts following this departure.
why_it_matters: Routine management change with limited immediate impact on operations.
